Do I need to provide a design?

desc:
Ecom Swift LLC delivers a WooCommerce store redesign that refreshes your shop, product, cart and checkout pages while keeping your products, web addresses and search titles exactly where they are.

## What is a WooCommerce store redesign?

A WooCommerce store redesign is a new look and layout for your existing shop. The visual design, page structure and styling change, while your product data, orders, customers and settings stay in place. It differs from a rebuild or a migration, because nothing moves to a different platform and your catalog is not recreated.

## Why a dated store costs you

Shoppers judge a store in seconds. A cluttered home page, small low-quality photos, a menu that hides categories or a checkout that looks unfinished all signal risk. People hesitate to enter card details on a store that looks neglected, even when the products are good.

Speed and mobile layout matter as much as appearance. An older theme may load slowly or break on a phone, and large uncompressed images make it worse. A redesign is the moment to fix both, so the new look is also lighter and easier to use.

## How design changes influence orders

Good design guides attention. A clear home page directs people to your main categories. A product page that shows large photos, price, options and delivery details in a logical order lets a shopper decide without hunting. A restyled cart and checkout with clear buttons and readable forms removes small points of friction.

Consistency builds trust: the same fonts, colors and button styles on every page tell visitors that a real business stands behind the shop. We do not promise a particular change in sales, since traffic, price and product also shape results. What we do is remove obvious barriers and keep everything that already works.

## What a careful redesign includes

- A review of your current pages and sales path before any design begins.
- A new look agreed with you: fonts, colors, buttons and spacing.
- Redesigned home, shop, category and product page layouts.
- Cart and checkout pages restyled for clarity.
- A new header, menu and footer that make categories easy to find.
- Product images refreshed and compressed for faster loading.
- Product links, page addresses and search titles left in place.
- A staging copy for building and review, so the live shop is untouched.
- A full test order and a mobile check before launch.

## How we work

We start by studying your current store: which pages draw visitors, how people reach checkout and what slows pages down. We agree a direction with you, using your logo, brand colors and any examples you like. A finished design is not something you have to bring.

We build on a staging copy of the shop. When you approve it, we move the changes live, place a full test order and check the main pages on a phone. The Basic package refreshes the home page and product page layout. Standard extends the new design across shop, category, cart and checkout, with a new header, menu and footer. Premium adds custom home page sections, several content pages, a speed pass and before and after screenshots.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Gather your best product photos and brand files before we begin.
- Tell us which pages and features you never want to lose.
- Review the staging copy on your own phone as well as a computer.
- Schedule the launch for a quieter time in your sales week.

**Avoid:**
- Changing product names or page addresses during the redesign.
- Adding every new feature you see on other stores.
- Using stock photos that do not match your actual products.
- Approving the design without checking the cart and checkout.

## Who this is for

This service suits an established shop whose design has not changed in years, an owner whose store looks fine on desktop but poorly on phones, and a brand that has outgrown its first template and wants a more polished look. It also suits a seller preparing for a campaign who wants the store ready first.

## What we need from you

Send your logo, brand colors and any pages you admire for reference. We need an administrator user for your store and, where your host allows, access to create a staging copy. We never need your password. We also ask for a short note on any pages or plugins that must stay exactly as they are.
